```{r}
# Load packages
pck <- c("sf","rnaturalearth", "sp",
         "here", "spatstat", "gt", "viridis", "viridisLite", "scico", "patchwork",
         "tidyverse","data.table","countrycode","CoordinateCleaner","fixr",
         "INLA","inlabru","INLAspacetime","broom","matrixStats", "fmesher", "terra", "MASS", "spatstat.geom") 
invisible(lapply(pck, require, character.only = TRUE))
# Using latest release of INLA for occupancy functions for INLA
project_folder = here::here()
inla.setOption(inla.call= paste0(project_folder, INLA_PATH))
seed = 42
```

**Context**

We are using site-occupancy models to analyse large databases of occurences such as GBIF. We wanted to use the very nice implementation of spatial autocorrelation in INLA (Lindgren & Rue 2015)

We use the available vignettes, but we identified a systematic bias when modelling spatial autocorrelation: the estimated spatial field often has a non-null average (uncentered spatial field), which bias the estimate of the intercept. Although the sum of both remain well estimated, this might be a problem in some context. So we would like to advertise that potential problem.

We start by using the simplest occupancy model possible, where $z_{i,t}$ represents the presence of a species at year $t$ and site $i$.

$z$ depends on the probability of occupancy $\psi_{i,t}$ through a Bernouilli law: $z_{i,t} = \mathcal{B}(\psi_{i,t})$. $\psi$ can depend on other variables through a logit link. Here we investigate several combinations of the following elements: a fixed intercept, a temporal trend and a spatial autocorrelation:

$$\text{logit}(\psi_{i,t}) = \alpha_{0} + \alpha_1 t +  \omega_i $$

The second part of the model is the detection part. Our data are detection data, $y_{i,t,k} = \mathcal{B}(p_{i,t,k} \times z_{i,t})$

$p_{i,t,k} = \beta_0$

Each year, a given proportion of sites are visited. and detection/non-detection data are generated for every visits of these sites. Here we fix it to 100% the proportion of visited sites for every year. When a site is visited in a given year we replicated visits 20 times per year.

```{r}
# Define the parameters of the dataset
n_years <- 5
n_visit <- 20
n_dataset <- 2

# value of intercepts and coeff in the model
prob_psi <- 0.3
prob_p <- 0.2
trend <- 0.5

# Parameters of spatial field and mesh
range <- 30
sigma_m <- 1
max_edge <- 6
```

We run our simulations on a simple spatial domain.

```{r}
# Define the spatial domain
nc <- 100 #number of grid cells across latitude
nr <- 100 #number of grid cells across longitude
n_sites <- nc*nr
# Define spatial domain
win <- owin(c(0,100), c(0,100))

Domain <- rast(nrows=nr, ncols=nc,
               xmax=win$xrange[2],xmin=win$xrange[1],
               ymax = win$yrange[2],ymin=win$yrange[1])

values(Domain) <- 1:ncell(Domain)
names(Domain)="cell_id"
locs <- crds(Domain) 

plot(Domain)
```

We simulate datasets with the parameters fixed above. First, the occupancy is computed on natural scale, then it is tranformed to the probability scale, and binary outcomes are drawn from this probability. The detections are simulated in the same way.

```{r}
# Simulating datasets
simulate_datasets <- function(n_sites, n_years, n_visit, max_edge, locs, range, sigma_m, prob_psi, prob_p, model, trend, n_dataset){
# Empty list of dataset 

list_dataset <- list()
    # Loop to fill the datasets
for (dt in 1:n_dataset){

    sites_list <- 1:n_sites # Spatial 
    years_list <- 1:n_years # Temporal primary 
    visit_list <- 1:n_visit # Temporal secondary 

    # Create the autocorrelated field 
    # Create the mesh 
    mesh <- fm_mesh_2d_inla(loc.domain=locs,
                        max.edge = c(1,2)*max_edge,
                        offset=c(max_edge, max_edge*5),
                        cutoff = max_edge/5)

    spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
      mesh        = mesh,
      prior.range = c(range, 0.5),   # Put prior centred on real value
      prior.sigma = c(sigma_m, 0.5),
      constr = TRUE
    )
    # Projector matrix
    A_sp <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, 
                            loc=locs)


    # Precision matrix
    Q = inla.spde2.precision(spde, theta = c(log(range),
                                                  log(sigma_m)))
    # Simulate the spatial field

    sim_field = inla.qsample(n = 1, Q = Q, seed = seed)

    # get the values to the real points
    omega <- (A_sp %*% sim_field)[,1]

    omega_yearly <- cbind(data.table(omega), replicate(n_years -1,omega))

    # Compute table of scale years for trends
    years_effect <- array(rep(scale(as.numeric(years_list)), each = length(sites_list)),
                      dim = c(length(sites_list), length(years_list)))

    # EMmpty matrix for z
    z <- matrix(nrow = 10000, ncol = n_years)

    # Chose model for occupancy
    if(model == "constant"){
        # True occupancy state
        for (i in 1:n_years){
           psi <- prob_psi
           z[,i] <- rbinom(n_sites, size = 1, prob = inla.link.logit(prob_psi, inverse=T))
        }
    }
    else if (model == "spatial"){
        # Occupancy probabilities
        psi <- inla.link.logit(prob_psi
          +  omega_yearly 
          , inverse = T)

        # True occupancy state
        for (i in 1:n_years){
            z[,i] <- rbinom(n_sites, size = 1, prob = psi[,i])
        }
    }

    else if(model == "trend"){
    # Occupancy probabilities
        psi <- inla.link.logit(prob_psi + trend*years_effect + omega_yearly, inverse = T)

        # True occupancy state
        for (i in 1:n_years){
            z[,i] <- rbinom(n_sites, size = 1, prob = psi[,i])
        }

    }

    # Detection probabilities and observed occurrences
    # Create empty matrix to store the results
    y <- array(NA,dim = c(n_sites, n_years, n_visit)) 
      
    # loop over visits
    for (i in 1:n_years){
        for(j in 1:n_visit){
              prob <- plogis(prob_p)*z[,i]
              y[,i,j] <- rbinom(n = n_sites,size = 1,prob = prob)
        } 
    }

    ##########################

    # Get into INLA format
    # Need scale years as a vector
    year <- as.vector(years_effect)
    # Prepar vector for INLA format 
    INLA_y <- c()

    # Visits table 
    for(i in 1:n_years){
        INLA_y = rbind(INLA_y, y[,i,])
    }

    # Get which replicates are NA 
    INLA_y_effort <- INLA_y
    INLA_y_effort[!is.na(INLA_y_effort)] <- 1



    # Occupancy covariates 
    INLA_occ <- data.frame(
              year_id = rep(years_list, each = n_sites),
              ID_grid = as.vector(rep(sites_list, n_years)),
              Int_z = 1,
              year_scaled = year,
              x_grid = rep(locs[,1], n_years),
              y_grid = rep(locs[,2], n_years),
              spatialfield = NA,
              occupancy=unlist(c(inla.link.logit(psi,inverse=TRUE))),
              presence=as.vector(z),
              true_int = rep(prob_psi, n_years*n_sites),
              trend = trend,
              idTime = NA)
      
    # Detection covariates 
    INLA_det <- data.frame(INLA_y_effort[,1])
      
    names(INLA_det) <- paste0(c("DetInt"),"_",1)
            
    for(k in 2:n_visit){
              tmp <- data.frame(INLA_y_effort[,k])
              names(tmp) <- paste0(c("DetInt"),"_",k)
              INLA_det <- cbind(INLA_det, tmp)
            }

    # Check and remove NAs in observation across visits
    keep = !apply(INLA_y,1,function(x)all(is.na(x)))
    INLA_y = INLA_y[keep,]

    # Keep full for predictions
    INLA_occ_pred = INLA_occ
    INLA_occ = INLA_occ[keep,]
    INLA_det = INLA_det[keep,]

      
    # Assemble the data 
            
    INLA_data = as.list(INLA_occ)
    INLA_data$Y = INLA_y
    INLA_data$X = INLA_det

    # Fill list of datasets
    list_of_data <- list(INLA_data, INLA_occ_pred)
    list_dataset[[dt]] <- list_of_data  
    }

return(list_dataset)
}
```

We also have a function to analyse the datasets, in which we vary the model according to the type of data we simulated. Priors have been chosen according to recommendations by...

```{r}
# Different values for occupancy intercept 
ptab=expand.grid(psi_vector=seq(-5, 5, 1),trend=c(-0.1,0))

# Generate three datasets per value 
list_dataset <- purrr::map2(ptab$psi_vector,ptab$trend,simulate_datasets,
                        n_sites = n_sites,
                          n_years = n_years,
                          n_visit = n_visit,
                          range = range,
                          sigma_m = sigma_m,
                          max_edge = max_edge,
                          locs = locs, 
                          prob_p = prob_p,
                          n_dataset = n_dataset,
                          model = "trend")

#exemple
tab=list_dataset[[5]][[1]][[2]]

pl1=ggplot(data=tab,aes(x=x_grid,y=y_grid,fill=occupancy))+

  xlab("Longitude")+ylab("Latitude")+
  labs(fill="Presence")

cowplot::plot_grid(pl1,pl2,ncol=1,align="hv")

```

```{r}
# Function to analyse the datasets

analyse_dataset_simple <- function(list_of_data, max_edge, range, sigma_m, prob_p, model, locs){


# Get the data and data for prediction
INLA_data <- list_of_data[[1]]
INLA_pred <- list_of_data[[2]]
# keep true value
true_int <- unique(INLA_data$true_int)

# Create a mesh for the analysis and spde
mesh <- fm_mesh_2d_inla(loc.domain=locs,
                     max.edge = c(1,2)*max_edge,
                    offset=c(max_edge, max_edge*5),
                    cutoff = max_edge/5)
  

spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh        = mesh,
  prior.range = c(range, 0.5), 
  prior.sigma = c(sigma_m, 0.5),
  constr = TRUE
)

A_sp_c <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, 
                         loc=cbind(INLA_data$x_grid, INLA_data$y_grid))

# Priors
hyper.prior.list.det <- list(beta1 = list(param = c(0,1/2.72),
                                          initial = 0))
  
hyper.pc.prec <- list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec",
                                  param = c(1,0.5)))

# defining the model formula for each case

if (model == "spatial"){
    formula <- inla.mdata(Y,X) ~  -1 + Int_z + f(spatialfield, model=spde,A.local = A_sp_c) 
    func = function(..., mesh_pred, data_pred){
    res = (Int_z*data_pred$Int_z +
            (mesh_pred %*% spatialfield)[,1]
    )
      return(res)
    }
}

else if(model == "constant"){
    formula <- inla.mdata(Y,X) ~  -1 + Int_z 
    func = function(..., data_pred, mesh_pred){
    res = (Int_z*data_pred$Int_z)
      return(res)
    }

}
else{
    formula <- inla.mdata(Y,X) ~  -1 + Int_z + year_scaled + f(spatialfield, model=spde,A.local = A_sp_c) 
    func = function(..., mesh_pred, data_pred){
    res = (Int_z + year_scaled*data_pred$year_scaled +
            (mesh_pred %*% spatialfield)[,1]
    )
      return(res)
    }
}

model_spat <- inla(formula, 
                                     data=INLA_data,  
                                     family= 'occupancy',  
                                     num.threads = 4,
                                     control.fixed =  list(prec = 1/2.72, prec.intercept = 1/2.72),
                                     control.compute = list(waic = TRUE, config = TRUE,
                                              residuals = T,
                                              return.marginals.predictor=TRUE), 
                       control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb"), 
                       control.family = list(control.link = list(model = "logit"), 
                                             link.simple = "logit",
                                             hyper = hyper.prior.list.det))

  

OccEff <- model_spat$summary.fixed 
DetEff <- model_spat$summary.hyperpar  

A_sp_c_pred <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, 
                         loc=cbind(INLA_pred$x_grid, INLA_pred$y_grid))

PostDistSamples <- inla.posterior.sample(250, model_spat) # get coef samples

# Apply function (merge coeff samples w/ new covariates)
PostDist_newCov <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(func, PostDistSamples,
                                                data_pred = INLA_pred, mesh_pred = A_sp_c_pred,
                                                HyperParam.summary = DetEff,
                                                Bern.trial = F, parallel.configs = FALSE)

# Get back on probability scale
PostDist_newCov_inv <- inla.link.logit(PostDist_newCov, inverse = T)

# Processing posterior distribution samples w/ chunks of sites x years combinaisons
chunks <- split(1:nrow(PostDist_newCov), ceiling(seq_along(1:nrow(PostDist_newCov))/5000)) # split per Batch_size
chunk_list <- list()
# For each row, there are 500 columns that are the post dist 
for(c in seq_along(chunks)){
    # subsets
    subset <- chunks[[c]]
    tmp <- PostDist_newCov[subset, , drop = FALSE]
    tmp_inv<- PostDist_newCov_inv[subset, , drop = FALSE]
    # avg/sd/ci
    mean_post <- rowMeans2(tmp)
    sd_post <- rowSds(tmp)
    mean_inv <- rowMeans2(tmp_inv)
    ci_inv <- rowQuantiles(tmp_inv, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
    
    # storing tmp results
    chunk_tmp <- data.frame(
      mean = mean_post,
      sd = sd_post,
      mean_invLogit = mean_inv,
      lci_invLogit = ci_inv[,1],
      uci_invLogit = ci_inv[,2])
    
    chunk_list[[c]] <- chunk_tmp

  }

# Bind with the metadata, because it has stayed in the same order 
Pred_data_plot <- cbind(INLA_pred[,c("ID_grid","year_scaled","year_id","x_grid","y_grid")],rbindlist(chunk_list))

# Now we get the results
if (model == "trend"){
    # if there is a trend, we are interested in the occupancy per year
      true_per_year <- true_int + trend*unique(Pred_data_plot$year_scaled)
      small_results <- Pred_data_plot %>%
        group_by(year_id)%>% 
        summarise(mean_year = mean(mean),
              sd = sd(mean)) 
      
      results_per_year <- tibble(
      year = unique(Pred_data_plot$year_id),
      pred_mean = small_results$mean_year,
      pred_sd = small_results$sd,
      coeff_mean = rep(model_spat$summary.fixed$mean[[1]], n_years),
      coeff_sd = rep(model_spat$summary.fixed$sd[[1]], n_years),
      coeff_lwr = rep(model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.025quant`[[1]], n_years),
      coeff_upr = rep(model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.975quant`[[1]], n_years),
      true = true_per_year,
      value = rep("occ_year", n_years))

      results_inter <- tibble(
      coeff_mean = model_spat$summary.fixed$mean[[1]],
      coeff_sd = model_spat$summary.fixed$sd[[1]],
      coeff_lwr = model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.025quant`[[1]],
      coeff_upr = model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.975quant`[[1]],
      true = true_int,
      value = "occ_int")

      results_trend <- tibble(
      coeff_mean = model_spat$summary.fixed$mean[[2]],
      coeff_sd = model_spat$summary.fixed$sd[[2]],
      coeff_lwr = model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.025quant`[[2]],
      coeff_upr = model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.975quant`[[2]],
      true = trend,
      value = "trend")
      }
else{
    # if no trend we just want the overall occupancy so we can directly do 
    occ_mean <- mean(Pred_data_plot$mean) # Occupancy on natural scale
    occ_sd <- sd(Pred_data_plot$mean)

    results_inter <- tibble(
      pred_mean = occ_mean,
      pred_sd = occ_sd,
      coeff_mean = model_spat$summary.fixed$mean[[1]],
      coeff_sd = model_spat$summary.fixed$sd[[1]],
      coeff_lwr = model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.025quant`[[1]],
      coeff_upr = model_spat$summary.fixed$`0.975quant`[[1]],
      true = true_int,
      value = "occ_int")

      
    results_per_year <- NULL
    results_trend <- NULL
      }


# if model is spatial 
if(model == "spatial" | model == "trend"){
      results_range <- tibble(
        coeff_mean = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$mean[[2]],
        coeff_sd = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$sd[[2]],
        coeff_lwr = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$`0.025quant`[[2]],
        coeff_upr = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$`0.975quant`[[2]],
        true = range,
        value = "range"
      )

      results_sigma <- tibble(
        coeff_mean = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$mean[[3]],
        coeff_sd = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$sd[[3]],
        coeff_lwr = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$`0.025quant`[[3]],
        coeff_upr = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$`0.975quant`[[3]],
        true = sigma_m,
        value = "sigma"
      )
}
else{
      results_range <- NULL
      results_sigma <- NULL
}

# results for detection, all models
results_det <- tibble(
  coeff_mean = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$mean[[1]],
  coeff_sd = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$sd[[1]],
  coeff_lwr = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$`0.025quant`[[1]],
  coeff_upr = model_spat$summary.hyperpar$`0.975quant`[[1]],
  true = prob_p,
  value = "det_int"
)

results <- bind_rows(results_inter, results_range, results_sigma, results_det, results_per_year, results_trend)

return(results)
}
```

First, we run the model without any spatial field. We start by varying the occupancy intercept.

```{r}
# Different values for occupancy intercept 
psi_vector <- seq(-4, 4, 0.2)

# Generate three datasets per value 
list_dataset <- sapply(psi_vector,
                        simulate_datasets,
                        n_sites = n_sites,
                          n_years = n_years,
                          n_visit = n_visit,
                          range = range,
                          sigma_m = sigma_m,
                          model = "constant",
                          max_edge = max_edge,
                          locs = locs, 
                          prob_p = prob_p,
                          n_dataset = n_dataset,
                          trend = trend)

# Get the results 
all_results <- lapply(list_dataset, analyse_dataset_simple, max_edge = max_edge, range = range, sigma_m = sigma_m, prob_p = prob_p, model = "constant", locs = locs)

results <- bind_rows(all_results)

parameters <- results %>%
  dplyr::select(coeff_mean, coeff_sd, true, value, coeff_lwr, coeff_upr)

occupancy <- results %>%
  dplyr::filter(value == "occ_int") %>%
  mutate(pred_lower = pred_mean - 1.96 * (pred_sd/sqrt(n_sites)),
         pred_upper = pred_mean + 1.96 * (pred_sd/sqrt(n_sites)))

p1=ggplot(data=parameters,aes(x=true,y=coeff_mean))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=coeff_lwr,ymax=coeff_upr),alpha=0.7)+
    geom_point(aes(y=true),color="red")+
  ylab("Parameter value/estimation")+
  xlab("Simulated value")+
  ggtitle("a",subtitle="Parameter estimation")+
  facet_wrap(~value,scales="free",labeller=labeller(variable = c(occ_int="Intercept Occupancy",
                  det_int="Intercept Detection")))+
  theme_bw()

        
p3=ggplot(data=occupancy,aes(x=true,y=pred_mean))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=pred_lower,ymax=pred_upper),alpha=0.7)+
  geom_point(aes(y=true),color="red")+
  ylab("Average occupancy probability")+
  ggtitle("b",subtitle="Overall occupancy estimation")+
  theme_bw()

p1
p3
```

Finally, this bias affect our estimate of the trend

```{r}

# Generate three datasets per value 
list_dataset <- sapply(psi_vector,
                        simulate_datasets,
                        n_sites = n_sites,
                          n_years = n_years,
                          n_visit = n_visit,
                          range = range,
                          sigma_m = sigma_m,
                          model = "trend",
                          max_edge = max_edge,
                          locs = locs, 
                          prob_p = prob_p,
                          n_dataset = n_dataset,
                          trend = trend)


# Get the results 

all_results <- lapply(list_dataset, , analyse_dataset_simple, max_edge = max_edge, range = range, sigma_m = sigma_m, prob_p = prob_p, model = "trend", locs = locs)

results <- bind_rows(all_results)

parameters <- results %>%
  dplyr::select(coeff_mean, coeff_sd, true, value, coeff_lwr, coeff_upr) %>%
  filter(value != "occ_year")


occupancy <- results %>%
  dplyr::filter(value == "occ_year") %>%
  mutate(pred_lower = pred_mean - 1.96 * (pred_sd/sqrt(n_sites)),
         pred_upper = pred_mean + 1.96 * (pred_sd/sqrt(n_sites)))

# 
p1=ggplot(data=parameters,aes(x=true,y=coeff_mean))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=coeff_upr,ymax=coeff_lwr),alpha=0.7)+
    geom_point(aes(y=true),color="red")+
  ylab("Parameter value/estimation")+
  xlab("Simulated value")+
  ggtitle("a",subtitle="Parameter estimation")+
  facet_wrap(~value,scales="free",labeller=labeller(variable = c(occ_int="Intercept Occupancy", range = "Spatial Range",
                  det_int="Intercept Detection", sigma = "Spatial variation"), trend = "Trend"))+
  theme_bw()

        
p3=ggplot(data=occupancy,aes(x=true,y=pred_mean))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=pred_lower,ymax=pred_upper),alpha=0.7)+
  geom_point(aes(y=true),color="red")+
  ylab("Average occupancy")+
  ggtitle("b",subtitle="Overall occupancy estimation")+
  facet_wrap(~year)+
  theme_bw()

p1
p3
```

Same, we look closer on the plot:

```{r}
p_zoom=ggplot(data=occupancy,aes(x=true,y=pred_mean))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=pred_lower,ymax=pred_upper),alpha=0.7)+
  geom_point(aes(y=true),color="red")+
  ylab("Average occupancy")+
  ggtitle("b",subtitle="Overall occupancy estimation")+
  ylim(0,1)+
  facet_wrap(~year)+
  theme_bw()

p_zoom
```
